title: Goodoo.ai Product Roadmap
subtitle: A 12-Month Strategic Plan for a Market-Leading Launch

phases.title: Months 1-3 (Q3 2025)
phases.subtitle: MVP Hardening & Beta Readiness
phases.description: Transition from a functional prototype to a stable, polished, and sellable Minimum Viable Product. The primary focus is on core functionality, reliability, and user experience to ensure a successful initial launch at the Odoo event and for the first 500 users.

initiatives.title: Chrome Extension Polish
items: Smart Recording Logic: Perfect auto-start/stop based on actual meeting activity
UI/UX Implementation: Finalize Loom-like UI for intuitive user control

initiatives.title: Core Platform Hardening
items: End-to-End User Flow: Ensure a seamless experience from recording to project-level chat
Visual Artifact Generation (Mocked Backend): Implement the UI for generating step-by-step guides from visual transcripts
Project Contextual Chat: Solidify the ability to select a video/source and have the chat contextually respond to it

initiatives.title: Infrastructure & Onboarding
items: Freemium Model Implementation: Build logic for the 2-hour visual transcription limit
Basic User Onboarding: Create a simple, guided setup process

successMetrics: A stable MVP ready for the Odoo event in September
The core user flow is reliable and intuitive for new users
Successful internal validation by the team (Shady, Hassan, Sara)

phases.title: Months 4-6 (Q4 2025)
phases.subtitle: Launch, Feedback & Iteration
phases.description: Successfully launch at the Odoo event, onboard the first cohort of beta users, and aggressively iterate based on real-world feedback. The focus shifts from core features to user activation and demonstrating the core value proposition of the 'project memory'.

initiatives.title: Beta User Onboarding & Support
items: High-Touch Onboarding: Personally onboard the first 100 beta users to maximize activation
Feedback Collection System: Implement a robust system to gather qualitative and quantitative data

initiatives.title: Visual Artifact Engine (V1)
items: Live AI Integration: Connect the frontend artifact generation UI to a live AI backend
Export Functionality: Allow users to export generated guides as PDF or Markdown

initiatives.title: Monetization & Billing
items: Subscription & Credit System: Fully implement the payment gateway for the Basic/Professional tiers and credit top-ups

successMetrics: A prioritized backlog of feature requests based on validated user needs
Clear data on feature usage, especially visual transcription and artifact generation

phases.title: Months 7-9 (Q1 2026)
phases.subtitle: Expansion & Intelligence
phases.description: Move beyond the initial feature set to deepen the product's intelligence and expand its integration capabilities. The focus is on making the platform indispensable for existing users and attractive to adjacent markets.

initiatives.title: Platform Expansion
items: Zoom/Microsoft Teams Integration: Expand the core recording and transcription functionality to other major meeting platforms

initiatives.title: Enhanced Intelligence
items: Cross-Project Memory (V1): Begin developing capabilities for the AI to reference knowledge across different projects
AI-Powered Search: Implement a semantic search feature that can find specific moments, decisions, or actions across all meetings within a project

initiatives.title: Collaboration Features
items: Team Workspaces: Introduce the ability to invite team members to collaborate on projects
Public Sharing Links: Allow users to share view-only versions of projects or specific artifacts

successMetrics: Increased user retention and engagement metrics
Successful acquisition of pilot users from non-Odoo segments
A platform that is demonstrably 'stickier' and more integrated into the user's workflow

phases.title: Months 10-12 (Q2 2026)
phases.subtitle: Scaling & Automation
phases.description: Focus on scalability, automation, and preparing the product and team for significant user growth. The goal is to refine the engine, automate workflows, and build out enterprise-ready features.

initiatives.title: Enterprise Readiness
items: Advanced User Permissions: Develop role-based access control for teams
Enterprise Billing & Custom Deals: Build the infrastructure to manage custom enterprise contracts

initiatives.title: Workflow Automation
items: Task Management Integration: Allow AI-identified action items to be pushed directly to popular PM tools
Automated Report Generation: Enable users to schedule recurring reports or summaries based on project activity

initiatives.title: Performance & Scalability
items: Infrastructure Optimization: Refactor and optimize backend services to handle a larger volume of concurrent users and data processing

successMetrics: A scalable platform ready for a public, mass-market launch
A clear path to landing the first enterprise-level clients
Product-market fit validated with strong retention and initial expansion revenue
